messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV-2 KV cache miss spike affecting /generate endpoints in us-west-2. Auto-escalation to on-call. Impact: increased p95 token latency, some requests falling back to CPU path. Link: https://internal.incidents/1987654321 :rotating_light:

oncall-alice: acked. I’m on it. Starting live triage in this thread — will update with timeline and mitigation steps. Paging @sre-bob and @eng-ml-carla for cache/serving signals.

sre-bob: seeing a sharp drop in prefix hit-rate on shard group kv-prod-7 around 13:23 UTC. Concurrent eviction counters spiked. Not sure if eviction was legitimate or triggered by rebalance.

eng-ml-carla: adding logs from the serving nodes (snip) — looks like a small set of prefixes got thrash:
```
[13:22:47] kv-store-7 INFO eviction triggered count=1245 free_mem_pct=6.2
[13:22:48] kv-store-7 WARN prefix_reclaim loop=3 prefix="user:session:.*" reclaimed=0
[13:22:49] kv-store-7 INFO incoming-rebalance from kv-prod-3 -> kv-prod-7 in_progress=true
[13:22:50] kv-store-7 ERROR cache-miss-hotprefix prefix_hash=0x8a4f9
```

ops-diego: confirmed cluster autoscaler kicked a few pods in us-west-2 at 13:20 for a burst in traffic. That might have triggered shard movement.

oncall-alice: immediate mitigation: 1) Pin traffic for affected customers to warm pool (route policy). 2) Increase prefix cache limit on kv-prod-7 by +20% (temp). 3) Disable rebalance for 10m on group kv-prod. Executing step 1 now.

eng-ml-carla: pushed config change to increase prefix budget on kv-prod-7 (rolling):
```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/kv/config -d '{"group":"kv-prod-7","prefix_budget":1.2}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer *****'
```

sre-bob: hit-rate graphs (13:10-13:40 UTC): overall KV hit-rate dropped from 98.7% -> 86.3% over ~6 minutes. Per-prefix heatmap shows a very small number of prefixes accounting for 60% of misses.

pm-raj: customer-impact check: we have ~12 customers with elevated error/latency spikes; partner A reported degraded quality for a subset of calls. No full outage reported. Marking for post-incident outreach.

oncall-alice: timeline so far: 13:18 surge in /embed and /generate traffic -> autoscaler adds pods 13:20 -> rebalance initiated 13:21-13:23 -> eviction cascade + prefix thrash 13:23 -> p95 latency climbs 13:24 -> mitigation steps started 13:26 -> prefix hit-rate stabilizing 13:32.

eng-ml-carla: hypothesis 1 (primary): rebalance moved a lease of hot prefixes onto kv-prod-7 while prefix budget was low, causing immediate eviction loops (eviction->miss->rehydrate->more evictions).

eng-ml-carla: hypothesis 2: a small client workload pattern produced very long prefixes that bypassed prefix-aggregation heuristics, creating hot-key storms — less likely given heatmap, but logging continued.

sre-bob: tests to validate: 1) inspect rebalance logs for prefix transfer list; 2) check MVCC timestamps to see if rehydrate latencies correlate; 3) compare per-prefix evict counters pre/post. I’ll run the rebalance audit now and paste output.

sre-bob: rebalance audit snippet:
```
REBALANCE_START id=rb-2026-06-03 src=kv-prod-3 dst=kv-prod-7 prefixes=124 entries=11k
TRANSFER_COMPLETE id=rb-2026-06-03 duration_ms=1023 transferred_prefixes=120
```

oncall-alice: nice — that matches the timing. @eng-ml-carla, can we add guard rails to abort rebalance if dest free_mem_pct < 10%? If yes, we should enqueue an infra change.

eng-ml-carla: we can. I’ll raise a short PR to add a precondition check. For immediate safety, I’ve disabled rebalance on kv-prod groups for 15m.

ops-diego: mitigation verification: after raising prefix budget and disabling rebalance, p95 tokens dropped from 480ms -> 180ms over ~6 minutes, and hit-rate climbed back to ~96%. Logging shows no new eviction storms.

pm-raj: recording customer impact & next steps: 1) outreach to affected customers with timeline and mitigation. 2) post-incident RCA to include rebalance precondition and better prefix warming. 3) add alert for "prefix-transfer-to-low-capacity" condition.

oncall-alice: action items assigned: @sre-bob to collect full evict/miss dump and write timeline artifacts; @eng-ml-carla to draft PR for rebalance precondition + prefix-warmup suggestion; @ops-diego to add temporary runbook notes for autoscaler interplay. I’ll draft the incident summary for oncall notes.

sre-bob: attaching a small log bundle (sanitized) to the incident ticket and saving heatmaps: https://internal.storage/incident-1987654321/logs.tar.gz

eng-ml-carla: quick note: we should consider implementing a short-lived prefix-hinting API so model-serving can mark prefixes intended to be hot during upscales. Putting that on the roadmap.

pm-raj: thanks everyone. Will prepare customer comms and schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow.

oncall-alice: closing live mitigation — system stable, monitoring for 2 hours. Will move this thread to incidents RCF for RCA drafting. :white_check_mark:
